newsitem.title: LATVIA: RIGA SAYS NEW S&P RATING DUE WEDNESDAY.
newsitem.headline: RIGA SAYS NEW S&P RATING DUE WEDNESDAY.

text.p: Latvian capital Riga said on Monday that the awarding of its new credit rating by Standard & Poors has been postponed to Wednesday.
"We will be informed (about the new rating) on Wednesday around 1100 (0800 GMT)," Inga Cerbule, Riga city finance department deputy director for investment credit questions, told Reuters.
She last week told Reuters that the new rating would be awarded on Friday, April 11.
"They (S&P) were one commission member short on Friday," Cerbule said.
Riga was awarded a BBB- long-term credit rating by Standard & Poors in January but has been seeking a higher one.
Standard & Poors has already rated Latvia BBB, which is investment grade.
Riga city was not satisfied with the BBB- and wanted S&P to review the rating.
